image_description: A hammerhead shark swimming in an aquarium environment, viewed from a slightly elevated side angle. The shark displays the characteristic T-shaped cephalofoil (hammer head) with eyes at the tips. The body is streamlined with visible dorsal and pectoral fins. Several smaller fish are scattered in the background against a dark, rocky substrate with some green algae or plant life.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows the iconic T-shaped head structure extending laterally from the body axis.
